svg.title: Overlay comparison
svg.desc: The Overlay tab compares two motions, A and B, overlaid or side by side on one clock. Today it uses the legacy shared Skill Lab server in Debug builds plus the bundled example; the cloud API stores comparison records but only exposes reads.

span.p: Choose A, you, and B, reference: the bundled example or a legacy Skill Lab project
